flows.title: Create a space
steps: On your computer, open Google Chat.
Click New chat, then Create a space.
Optional: to give the space a picture, click Choose an emoji and select one.

flows.title: Send a direct message
steps: On your computer, open Google Chat. The first time you write to someone, they have to accept the request before you can chat.
Enter a name or an email address. To start a group message, add more names or email addresses.
In the reply area, enter a message and click Send.

flows.title: Turn a direct message into a space
steps: This works when two or more people are in the direct message.
On your computer, open Google Chat.
At the top, click the conversation name.
Click Turn this chat into a space.
